n1.title: End of term assessments start on Monday 12 October
n1.body: Assessments run from Monday 12 to Friday 16 October for Grade 1 to Grade 9. Please make sure learners arrive by 7:45 am and have had breakfast.

n2.title: Fee balances are due by Friday 9 October
n2.body: Kindly clear any Term 3 balance before assessments begin. Pay through M-Pesa Pay Bill using the learner admission number as the account number.

n3.title: Staff meeting on Thursday at 3:30 pm
n3.body: We will agree on invigilation duties and the report card timeline. Bring your assessment records.

n4.title: Grade 7 science project showcase
n4.body: Parents of Grade 7 learners are welcome on Wednesday 14 October from 2:00 pm to see the Integrated Science projects.
